name: load
rule: all rows of all fiscal-year snapshots
note: dropped owner columns: owner_name, owner_coownername, owner_address, owner_address2, owner_city, owner_state, owner_zip; text 'None' read as missing; sale date 01/01/1900 and book/page '/' treated as no sale recorded

name: has_sale
rule: sale price and sale date both present

name: dedupe
rule: same parcel + date + price seen in several snapshots -> keep the first snapshot
note: features come from the snapshot closest after the sale

name: price_corrections
rule: same parcel + date with different prices in different snapshots -> keep the most recent snapshot (treated as a correction)

name: window
note: first snapshot (FY2016) records sales up to 2015-07-14; earlier years only show each home's last sale as of then (incomplete)

name: residential
note: largest removed classes: 4-8-UNIT-APT (152); GEN-OFFICE (59); OFFICE-CONDO (46); >8-UNIT-APT (39); RETAIL-STORE (34); MULTIUSE-RES (34)

name: flag_multi_parcel
rule: several parcels recorded on the same deed and date (price is often a total for all of them)

name: flag_ppsf_extreme
rule: price per sq ft in bottom/top 0.5% of its group

name: main_sample
rule: main sample excludes flag_low_ratio and flag_multi_parcel
note: excluded rows stay in the file for robustness checks
